# Shivam Goyal - Applied AI Engineer & 2x Microsoft MVP

## Who is Shivam Goyal?

**Q: What is Shivam Goyal's professional background and expertise?**
A: Shivam Goyal is a 2x Microsoft MVP (AI, 2024-2025), Associate Consultant at Ernst & Young (EY) Technology Consulting, and Applied AI Engineer specializing in agentic systems, Azure AI, Microsoft Foundry, LLMOps, and RAG architectures. He designs production-ready enterprise AI solutions, multi-agent orchestration workflows, and AI platform engineering architectures.

**Q: What are Shivam Goyal's main areas of expertise?**
A: Agentic AI systems and multi-agent orchestration, Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI services, LLMOps and prompt optimization, RAG architectures, AI platform engineering, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, and semantic search.

**Q: What tools and frameworks does Shivam Goyal work with?**
A: Microsoft Agent Framework, Foundry Local, Azure AI Agent Service, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Ollama, and Python.

## AI Agents Series

A 10-part series on building AI agents, starting at the [series overview](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/agents-series/).

- [Part 1: Introduction](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-1-intro/): AI agents fundamentals and power
- [Part 2: Frameworks](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-2-frameworks/): Exploring agentic AI frameworks
- [Part 3: Principles](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-3-principles/): Key principles for building reliable agents
- [Part 4: Tool use](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-4-tool-use/): Mastering tool use design patterns
- [Part 5: RAG](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-5-rag/): Agentic retrieval-augmented generation
- [Part 6: Trustworthy agents](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-6-trustworthy/): Building trustworthy and responsible agents
- [Part 7: Planning](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-7-planning/): Planning and orchestration patterns
- [Part 8: Multi-agent](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-8-multi-agent/): Multi-agent design patterns and coordination
- [Part 9: Metacognition](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-9-metacognition/): Metacognition for self-aware intelligence
- [Part 10: Production](https://shivamgoyal03.github.io/articles/series/part-10-production/): Deploying agents to production
